opportunities.title: Cronos Just Proved Every 'Decentralized' Chain Has an Undo Button
opportunities.why_now: Crypto.com's Cronos halted its entire network after a $75M Tectonic exploit, the second major chain to freeze mid-hack this week.
opportunities.angle: Security-led explainer on validator-controlled halts as the industry's real disaster recovery plan — and what that means for 'decentralization' marketing

opportunities.title: An Attacker Just Got 10% of Fogo's Supply. The Fix Was to Turn the Chain Off.
opportunities.why_now: Fogo halted mainnet after an attacker received 400M FOGO tokens (10% of circulating supply), one of two chain-level halts in 48 hours.
opportunities.angle: Short, sharp breakdown of what a supply-shock exploit does to a token's game theory, and why halting is the tell that governance is more centralized than advertised

opportunities.title: Cosmos Labs Cleared a Bug That Was Actually Live. Then $5.7M Walked Out the Door.
opportunities.why_now: Cosmos Labs admitted it wrongly signed off on the exact vulnerability behind a six-chain $5.7M exploit.
opportunities.angle: Audit-trust postmortem — what 'wrongly cleared' means for anyone relying on a security review as a green light

opportunities.title: Real Trump Coins Says the GOLD Rug Wasn't Them. Convenient.
opportunities.why_now: A Trump-linked account promoted GOLD before it collapsed, and the official entity is now blaming 'bad actors' for the token it appeared to endorse.
opportunities.angle: Security-skeptic take on affiliation laundering — how token launches borrow credibility from brands that later deny involvement, and what to check before the next 'endorsed' coin drops

opportunities.title: A $1.1M Card Hack Just Wiped 49% Off a Neobank's Token — Here's the Math That Made That Possible
opportunities.why_now: A relatively small $1.1M exploit crashed a crypto neobank's token by nearly half, showing how thin the buffer is between operational security and token price.
opportunities.angle: Numbers-driven piece connecting security failures directly to tokenomics fragility — a template for sizing 'how bad can this get' before investing in any card/neobank token
